gaps.explanation: Statement governmental receipts 3,637,723 = p4 Total Governmental Funds TOTAL RECEIPTS. Schedule 3,637,863: General Fund budget p7 1,965,763 + Inheritance Tax Fund p5 131,715 + Veteran's Aid p5 1,353 + Road Fund budget p8 1,398,503 + American Rescue Plan budget p9 77,179 + non-major p6 63,350 = 3,637,863. The 140 difference is in the Road Fund: the p8 budgetary comparison schedule prints Local 7,975 (TOTAL RECEIPTS 1,398,503), while the p4 statement prints Road Fund Local 7,835 (TOTAL RECEIPTS 1,398,363) and Sale of assets 140 under Other Financing Sources; 7,975 - 7,835 = 140. The budget schedule counts the sale of assets as a receipt, the statement as other financing; both are printed as such and the 140 is inside the single printed p8 line 'Local' (detail index 25), so no line is missing or duplicated. 3,637,863 - 140 = 3,637,723.

Statement transfers in 301,593 = p4 Total Governmental Funds (General Fund column 106,953 + Road Fund 194,640). Detail records the per-fund schedules gross: General Fund budget p7 Transfers - in 25,318 + Inheritance Tax Fund p5 275,365 + Road Fund p8 194,640 = 495,323. The p5 combining General Fund statement prints Total General Fund transfers in 300,683 (25,318 + 275,365) but the p4 General Fund column prints 106,953: the transfers between the General Fund's own sub-funds (General Fund to Inheritance Tax Fund) are netted out on p4. 300,683 - 106,953 = 193,730 = gap; 495,323 - 193,730 = 301,593. Gross per-fund transfers vs a netted statement column: no fix.

Statement transfers out 301,593 = p4 Total Governmental Funds (General Fund 194,640 + American Rescue Plan 106,760 + Non-Major 193). Detail: General Fund budget p7 Transfers - out (388,370) + ARPA p9 (106,760) + DARE and Drug Fund p6 (193) = 495,323. The p5/p7 General Fund transfers out 388,370 include 193,730 moved to its own Inheritance Tax sub-fund, which p4 nets out of the General Fund column (194,640); 388,370 - 194,640 = 193,730 = gap; 495,323 - 193,730 = 301,593. Same intra-General Fund transfer as transfers_in; gross vs net, no fix.
